facts.text: The hotel overlooks the Stadtpark in the heart of Vienna.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the ornate Stadtpark, InterContinental Vienna puts you in the heart of the city.

facts.text: The Stadtpark is located opposite the hotel's main entrance.
facts.excerpt: Stadtpark, located opposite the main entrance of the hotel, is an oasis of calm and relaxation right in the city centre.

facts.text: The hotel is moments away from the Vienna State Opera and shopping on pedestrianised Kaerntner Strasse.
facts.excerpt: The InterContinental Vienna hotel places you moments away from the world-renowned Vienna State Opera and stylish shopping on pedestrianised Kaerntner Strasse.

facts.text: Behind its functionalist exterior, the hotel has a wood-panelled lobby hung with chandeliers.
facts.excerpt: Behind its functionalist exterior, the hotel's magnificent wood-panelled lobby is hung with chandeliers

facts.text: The hotel has a grand ballroom for hosting events.
facts.excerpt: our grand ballroom is ideal for hosting elegant events

facts.text: Club InterContinental guests enjoy a 180-degree panoramic view over downtown Vienna from the Club Lounge on the 12th floor.
facts.excerpt: Club InterContinental guests enjoy a 180-degree panoramic view over downtown Vienna from the Club Lounge on the 12th floor of the hotel

facts.text: Classic rooms blend traditional and contemporary furnishings and have views of the Stadtpark or the Vienna Concert Hall.
facts.excerpt: Our Classic rooms elegantly blend traditional and contemporary furnishings, and have lovely views of the Stadtpark or Vienna Concert Hall.

facts.text: Cafe Vienna is a Viennese coffee house serving coffee specialties and pastries, with traditional afternoon tea in the afternoon.
facts.excerpt: Café Vienna is a typical Viennese coffee house with coffee specialties, pastries, and typical cold and hot dishes. In the afternoon, traditional afternoon tea is served.

facts.text: The Intermezzo Bar has a polished central bar under an opulent chandelier and serves fine wines, whiskies and cocktails.
facts.excerpt: With a polished central bar under an opulent chandelier, the sophisticated Intermezzo Bar serves fine wines, whiskies and cocktails

facts.text: Concerts at the Vienna Konzerthaus and Musikverein are within easy reach by subway.
facts.excerpt: Concerts at the Vienna Konzerthaus and Musikverein are within easy reach by subway.

facts.text: Fashion boutiques on Kaerntner Strasse and Kohlmarkt are a short stroll away.
facts.excerpt: Fashion boutiques on Kärntner Strasse and Kohlmarkt are a short stroll away.

facts.text: The Stadtpark opposite the hotel has a golden Johann Strauss monument.
facts.excerpt: its golden Johann Strauss monument is one of the world's most frequently photographed memorials

facts.text: The hotel is certified with the Austrian Eco-Label and holds Green Key certification.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is certified with the Austrian Eco-Label and adheres to the strict requirements of Green Engage, IHG’s global CSR programme. We are also proud to hold the international Green Key certification

facts.text: Pet dogs are allowed in guest rooms.
facts.excerpt: Pet dogs are allowed in room.

facts.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
facts.excerpt: No, InterContinental Vienna does not have a pool.

facts.text: The hotel has a state-of-the-art fitness centre.
facts.excerpt: You can also work out in the state-of-the-art fitness centre

facts.text: The hotel was named Austria's Leading Business Hotel by the World Travel Awards.
